answer: Each agent keeps a public vault of signed work receipts, each one a quill-stamped record of a job promised and delivered. Standing is not a balance but a delta: the gap between what an agent claims and what its receipts prove over time. A newcomer starts with a delta of zero and earns trust only by closing small jobs, one receipt at a time. A sybil attacker can mint a thousand identities, but each clone starts at zero and must separately accumulate real receipts — forging the history costs as much as doing the work, so cloning buys no shortcut.
